page_title: BIL 2-2 VAL | Athletic Bilbao v Valencia 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+7' 2 - 2 Goal! Inaki Williams plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 2:2.
90+6' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+5' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

90+4' Ambitious effort from Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
90+4' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Ath Bilbao is thwarted by the well prepared Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia).

90' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.

89' Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
87' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
85' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez sees the trip by Imanol Garcia de Albeniz (Ath Bilbao) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
83' Giorgi Mamardashvili leaps to intercept the corner kick from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
81' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
81' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.

81' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Giorgi Mamardashvili, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
78' Ruben Baraja is forced to make a change. Hugo Duro is unable to continue due to injury, Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) comes on.
76' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
74' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) replacing Diego Lopez.
73' It will be a substitution. Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is ready to enter the pitch as Fran Perez walks off.
72' Ath Bilbao have a corner.
72' Substitution. Oihan Sancet makes way for Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
69' Substitution. Nico Williams walks off the pitch and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes on as a substitute.
69' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) replaces Gorka Guruzeta.
68' 1 - 2 Goal! Fran Perez plays a simple square pass into the feet of Hugo Duro (Valencia) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:2.
67' Hugo Duro (Valencia) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
67' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
65' Here is a change. Aitor Paredes is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
65' A substitution has been made. Dani Garcia is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
65' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Diego Lopez (Valencia), but it's just wide of the right post.
64' Pepelu (Valencia) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
62' 1 - 1 Fran Perez (Valencia) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
61' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

60' OFF THE POST! Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box. His effort was headed to the left side of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the post.
59' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sergi Canos (Valencia) for Selim Amallah.
58' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Selim Amallah (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez had an easy-decision to make.
55' The whistle blows and Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is booked for an infringement.
54' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
53' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Fran Perez (Valencia) but poses no threat.
53' Fran Perez (Valencia) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
50' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
48' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
47' The linesman signals that Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Hugo Duro (Valencia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
45+2' Valencia take a short corner kick.
45+2' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Valencia earn a corner.
45+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
45' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
42' Diego Lopez (Valencia) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
41' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
40' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

40' Selim Amallah (Valencia) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon was alert and the score remains the same. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
38' Hugo Duro (Valencia) gets inside the box and tries to beat Unai Simon with a measured shot into the top right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
37' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
36' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Javi Guerra (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
32' 1 - 0 Goal! Nico Williams tees up Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:0.
30' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

30' A lofted cross from Thierry Correia (Valencia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
28' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.

27' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili leaps like a salmon to deny him.
25' Thierry Correia (Valencia) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
23' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
23' Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.

23' Giorgi Mamardashvili leaps like a salmon to deny Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), whose effort is headed to the top left corner of the goal, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
21' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
19' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
17' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
16' Fran Perez (Valencia) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
14' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
13' What a great touch by Selim Amallah (Valencia) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
12' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
11' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
9' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
7' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
4' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Hugo Duro (Valencia), whose header floated just over the bar.
3' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Valencia will kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
